key: Troya never asks for your seed phrase or your private key. Here is who holds what, what Troya can and cannot do with your money, and how to check every line yourself, with no account and no wallet.
If anyone claiming to be Troya does one of these, it is not Troya. Report it in the <1>Community</1> page or the Telegram group.
Ask for your seed phrase or key
Not in the app, not on X, not in Telegram, not ever. Nothing Troya does needs it.
The team never opens a private chat with you. The Troya bot writes to you only after you link it yourself in the app, for your alerts. Anyone else who DMs you as Troya is an impostor.
Every trade from your own wallet is signed in that wallet, by you. Troya prepares it and shows you the check; it cannot send it.
Send your Agent Wallet anywhere else
A withdrawal from your Agent Wallet can only go to your own connected wallet. There is no other address it can be sent to.
On a coin launched through Troya, your share of the fee is fixed in a contract when the coin launches. Nobody, Troya included, can change it.
Three places, three rules. The full detail, keys for Hyperliquid and Lighter included, is on <1>Risk Controls</1>.
Troya never sees or stores its key.
Every swap, launch and claim waits for your signature in the wallet itself.
Disconnect at any time; nothing keeps running in its name.
Used for launching and trading from X and Telegram; it holds only what you send it.
Acts only inside your own caps, and not at all while you pause it.
Withdraws only to your own wallet. Export its key whenever you like.
Kept encrypted on Troya's server, so keep in it only what you would carry in a pocket.
Hold {0} $TROYA: the whole creator fee goes straight to your wallet.
Otherwise a fee-split contract pays you {0}% of volume and Troya {1}%. Your share and your address are fixed when the coin launches.
The contract has no function to move your part or point the fees anywhere else. Troya's share can never be set above {0}% of a creator's fees.
Claim in one click on the <1>Creator desk</1>; anyone may trigger the payout, and it always pays you.
Every claim on this page can be read from a plain browser. These are the shortest ways in.
Troya's code is public, the fee-split contract and its tests included. <1>github.com/troyaagent/troya-agent</1>
The factory on Robinhood Chain, <1>0x2663…F525</1>. Troya only uses it after checking its bytecode against the tested build: <2>build and source</2>.
Real-money tests with their signers, from the first day: <1>Verify</1> and its <2>proof.json</2>.
Each coin Troya Sentry posts and each coin born through Troya, with what its price did next: <1>The Record</1>.
The nine checks Troya Gate runs before any swap, and the limits it cannot skip: <1>Risk Controls</1>. Try it on any coin: <2>Gate a coin</2>.
$TROYA is <1>0x1FA8…a074</1>. Any other address is not $TROYA.
